#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int longestOutsideWord(const std::string& s, int n) {
    int max_len = -1;
    int current = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '_') {
            max_len = std::max(max_len, current);
            current = 0;
        } else if (c != '(' && c != ')') {
            ++current;
        } else {
            max_len = std::max(max_len, current);
            current = 0;
            ++i;
            while (s[i] != ')') {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }
    return std::max(max_len, current);
}

int countInsideWords(const std::string& s, int n) {
    int words = 0;
    int current = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        while (i < n && s[i] != '(') {
            ++i;
        }
        if (i == n) {
            break;
        }
        ++i;
        while (s[i] != ')') {
            char c = s[i];
            if (c == '_') {
                if (current > 0) {
                    ++words;
                }
                current = 0;
            } else {
                ++current;
            }
            ++i;
        }
        if (current > 0) {
            ++words;
        }
        current = 0;
    }
    return words;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;

    int longestOutside = longestOutsideWord(s, n);
    int insideWords = countInsideWords(s, n);

    std::cout << longestOutside << " " << insideWords << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
